assertions.text: Identifies that the domain entity imports the Drizzle table/schema directly, violating inward-only dependency direction
Identifies that the toRow() row-mapping method lives inside the domain entity and should move to an adapter-level mapper
Proposes a concrete fix: the entity depends only on primitive/domain types, and mapping to $inferInsert/$inferSelect happens in a separate mapper
Provides corrected code implementing the fix, not just a description of the problem
